structural_contract_verification.threshold_only_explanation: close > zone_high alone is NOT sufficient; compression_observed must be True (phase 1) AND directional close must accompany escape (phase 2) AND hold evidence required (phase 3)

separation_from_v1_verified.v1_mechanism: close > zone_high + PC1_ENTRY_BREAK_BUFFER_ATR * atr (0.00 default) — a single threshold check with optional near-edge bias softening
separation_from_v1_verified.v2_mechanism: Three sequential phases: COMPRESSION (range_ratio check), RELEASE (escape+directional close), EXPANSION_HOLD (prior_outside or clearly_away)

structure_test_cases.description: All three phases present: tight compression, directional close above zone, clearly_away hold

structure_test_cases.name: T2_no_compression
structure_test_cases.description: Wide ranging bars before breakout — no coil. Phase 1 fails, signal suppressed.

setup.note: Trending bars with wide high-low range inflate range_ratio above threshold

v1_mechanism.trigger: close > zone_high + PC1_ENTRY_BREAK_BUFFER_ATR * atr (default buf=0.00) — single threshold. Softened: close >= zone_high - 0.12*atr AND close > prev_close AND macro_bias_supportive.

v2_mechanism.trigger: Three sequential phases: COMPRESSION (range_ratio <= 1.2), RELEASE (directional close escape > 0.05*atr), EXPANSION_HOLD (prior_outside OR clearly_away >= 0.15*atr)

comparison_scenarios.description: Tight compression + directional close + clearly away. Both v1 and v2 fire.
comparison_scenarios.conclusion: Agreement on genuine structural breakout — expected.

comparison_scenarios.description: Wide pre-breakout range (no coil). Neither fires due to zone range.
comparison_scenarios.conclusion: Agreement — this case is outside v1's zone window range anyway.

comparison_scenarios.description: Wick above zone, bearish close. Neither fires (v1 also requires close > zone_high which fails as close=1.1001 < zone_high=1.1004).
comparison_scenarios.conclusion: Agreement — v2 explicitly names the fail reason; v1 silently doesn't trigger.

comparison_scenarios.description: Close barely escaped zone (1.10050 > 1.1004), prior bar inside, NOT clearly away. V1 fires. V2 suppresses.
comparison_scenarios.conclusion: KEY DIVERGENCE: v1 fires on spike rejections that immediately return to zone. v2 correctly suppresses these — the breakout is not holding.

comparison_scenarios.description: Close near edge (within 0.12*atr below zone_high) with macro_bias support — v1 near-edge fires. V2: close < zone_high + 0.05*atr → RELEASE fails.
comparison_scenarios.conclusion: KEY DIVERGENCE: v1's near-edge softening allows entries where close hasn't actually escaped the zone. v2 requires a real escape distance + directional close.

divergence_summary.key_finding: v2 is strictly more conservative than v1 on structural grounds. The 2 v1-only signals correspond exactly to two known noise patterns: spike rejections (no hold) and near-edge soft triggers (no real escape). v2 suppresses these explicitly.

comparison_to_v1_reference.reference_config_compatibility_note: entry_v23_policy_strict_active_only.json uses include_entry_families=['EXPANSION_BREAKOUT']. v2 is a drop-in detector for this family — it produces is_valid=True only when the structural breakout is real. When integrated, the reference config's context_exclusions and micro_confirm still apply as outer gates.

structural_verdict_rationale: entry_breakout_v2.py implements three independently verifiable phases. Each phase check can be individually disabled and the signal suppresses. No single threshold comparison produces a valid signal. The phases (COMPRESSION, RELEASE, EXPANSION_HOLD) correspond to observable real-world market preconditions, not score accumulation. This meets the TASK-001 done_when conditions.
